title: Packet latency measurements in experimental TSN-capable networks

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Original measurements by Manuel Cheminod, Marc Ruiz Ramírez, Luis Velasco Esteban and Claudio Zunino (2024). Derived file-level summaries and transport-age proxy computed for G1.

evidence: Primary documentation inspected and all 20 public receiver reports downloaded, digest-verified and parsed.
population: Static laboratory UDP traffic replay in Torino, February–March 2024. Two UDP streams, two repetitions; AP, NXP1028, chained NXP1028–AP, and Wi-Fi–NUC at 2.4/5 GHz. Ground-robot motion and closed-loop control performance were not measured.
selection: Selected every receiver_*.txt in data/results/ and the two methodological documents; the generator input was unneeded. Only file-level aggregates and hashes are redistributed.
schema_and_clock: ReadMe.txt and Description.pdf pp. 1–2: id is an incremental per-stream packet index. The unused payload field, txtime, hwtime, rxtime, systime and UDP payload length complete the seven integer fields. Generator records txtime into the sent UDP payload; sender and receiver NIC clocks are synchronized. The NUC Wi-Fi receiver lacks hardware timestamps; PTP aligns its Ethernet PHC to the generator, and phc2sys aligns its system clock. Interrupt/software delays remain in its receive timestamps. Absolute error after synchronization is not quantified per packet.
computation: Apply integer timestamp arithmetic in ns. Wired latency = hwtime - txtime; Wi-Fi = rxtime + 37000000000 - txtime. Convert to microseconds only after subtraction. Each CSV row is one original file; quantile uses ascending rank ceil(0.95*n). Every file contained a contiguous sequence 0–9999 and nondecreasing send and corrected receive timestamps. No internal sequence gaps establishes completeness within that observed range, not reliability of other traffic.
age_proxy: For each stream, use transmit time as generation time only for a transport-level age proxy. Over the observed interval from first to last reception, let d_i = receive_i - transmit_i and h_i = receive_(i+1) - receive_i. Time-weighted mean age = sum(d_i*h_i + h_i^2/2)/sum(h_i), i=0..n-2. There are no stale/out-of-order updates under these checks. True controller/sensor AoI requires sample generation times and application-use times, which these files do not supply.
quality_notes: Description.pdf Table 4 middle four Wi-Fi rows have conflicting filename versus band/port labels. The matching statistics follow band/port metadata, not the printed filenames. CSV uses the publisher file paths and measured contents.
For receiver_1027-2.4g-TEST1.txt the observed minimum is 496.830 µs; the corresponding Table 4 numeric row prints 493.83 µs. Retained file-derived result.
One-way latency is supported at the documented timestamping layers. The clock correction is specific to this dataset; transport-age estimates do not establish timing on a mobile robot.

query_log.query: Packet latency measurements in experimental TSN-capable networks
query_log.action: Screened author dataset directory and followed its CORA RDR deposit.

query_log.query: doi:10.34810/data1885 version 1.0, then all data/results/receiver reports
query_log.action: Checked release and license, read methodological documents, validated all receiver file MD5/size against version manifest, independently computed SHA-256 and aggregate statistics.

reproduction.requirements: Python 3 standard library. Supply all 20 files from the CSV download_url column, retaining the release directory tree or saving each file with its numeric file ID; several source basenames repeat across directories.
reproduction.offline_metadata: Save the JSON from version_metadata_url before running offline. Individual receiver file paths may replace the input directory. Compare outputs with cmp recalculated.csv tsn-packet-timing.csv.
reproduction.exact_option: Add --exact to append latency_sum_ns, transport_age_twice_area_ns2 and observation_duration_ns. Divide the first by packet_rows for exact mean delay in ns; divide twice-area by twice the duration for exact time-mean transport age in ns. Epoch timestamps and time differences are handled as integers; only displayed microsecond means are rounded.
reproduction.verification: Both directory and explicit-file input regenerated the saved CSV byte-for-byte. An incomplete list failed. All 20 exact-integer results matched the displayed means within half a unit in the last displayed decimal place (allowing floating-point roundoff).
